g.text: FM004 — Multiline YAML syntax in description
field uses a multiline YAML indicator (
Claude Code runtime accepts this syntax, but single-line strings are the
documented convention and are easier to read.
skills.md examples show single-line description values. No normative
clause prohibits multiline syntax — this is a style preference.
Convert the description to a single-line string:
Returns: List containing one warning when the description used a block
scalar or the parsed string still contains a newline; empty otherwise.
